[d0828] config | coordinator.queue_capacity | version 4.x
# `coordinator.queue_capacity`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `100` |
| Available since | 3.1 |
| Component | coordinator |
| Unit | tasks |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `coordinator.queue_capacity` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[coordinator]
queue_capacity = 100
```

---

[d0121] config | coordinator.queue_capacity (PaderQueue 3.x) | version 3.x
# `coordinator.queue_capacity` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `5000` |
| Available since | 3.1 |
| Component | coordinator |
| Unit | tasks |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `coordinator.queue_capacity` only if you observe problems with the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[coordinator]
queue_capacity = 5000
```
